title: Senior Manager - Domestic Logistics ( Spare Parts & Machines )
description:
WIRTGEN INDIA is a member of the WIRTGEN GROUP, and a John Deere Company, that specializes in the sales and service for road construction equipment and mining machinery incorporating the traditional product brands: WIRTGEN, VÖGELE, HAMM, KLEEMANN.
   

  

 We build our company with people like you. Your skills and abilities are what makes our company strong. Working together as a cohesive, quality minded team, the Wirtgen group provides our customers with the highest level of quality products, service and support.
   

  

**We are seeking a**
 Senior Manager \- Domestic Logistics ( Spare Parts \& Machines )
   

  

**Location: Working remotely from Navi Mumbai
   

  

 Head Office: WIRTGEN INDIA Pvt. Ltd., Dist Pune, 412214, Maharashtra, India
   

  

 Basic Requirements:**
* Educational Qualification:
* Educational Qualification: Graduate \& PG with specialization in Logistics/ SCM/ Transportation Management
* Age: \~ 40Years
* Experience: \~ 18\- 20 years


**Purpose of the Job:** 
 To lead, Manage \& develop efficiently end\-to\-end transportation and last Mile delivery for spare parts and finished machines, ensuring timely, cost\-effective, safe, and customer\-focused delivery across PAN India to support overall business objectives.The role is responsible for Spare parts / Machines last mile deliveries from 23 Warehouses to end customers by innovative transportation options and complied vendor management.
   

  

**Scope of Work \& Accountabilities:**
* Last Mile delivery improvement strategy\- On time, Cost effective, Compliant and Safe delivery
* Domestic transportation and distribution operations across India (Majorly ODA Locations)
* Strategic transportation planning and execution
* All transportation \& commercial agreements to finalize for PAN India transportation
* Selection of right service providers/ Transporters for delivery to meet Organization goals
* Time bound delivery planning and solutions to Customers/ Regions
* Customer Centric approach and Parts logistics related complaints to analyze
* Logistics cost optimization in PTL/ FTL modes
* Stakeholder management –Customer Service, Warehouse, Zonal Teams, Accounts, etc
* Develop Cost Effective \& Efficient Transportation \& Courier Services / Solutions for PAN India
* Effective usage of Transport Management System and analytics
* Route mapping and Cargo allocation automation as per service levels
* Monthly MIS \& Reporting on Service levels/ Freight analysis/ Zone / delivery perfo. etc
* Service performance review with internal stakeholders, service providers \& meeting with vendors monthly for improvement plans \& new initiatives.
* Implement best practices in Domestic Logistics to improve customer satisfaction
* Logistics Dept. Compliance and Update SOPs for logistics management viz Vehicle planning, Con\-signment Booking, Tracking \& Vehicle loading process
* Define and monitor SLAs, KPIs, TAT and Service levels
* Cross Functional team interaction and expertise
* Domestic Logistics Budget and drive cost optimization initiatives


**Skills / Competencies required:**
* Strong knowledge of Indian transportation industry/ Logistics updates
* Commercial negotiation and vendor management
* Data driven decision making and analytics
* Very good interpersonal skills
* Networking in logistics industry and explore best practice concepts
* Crisis management \& Solution driven approach
* Good team Player, acceptance to new ideas and implementation
* Strong System, MS Office, ERP and process oriented


**Reporting** 
 Head \-Logistics \& Warehousing
   

  

 If you would like to learn more about the Wirtgen Group visit our website Wirtgen Group in India .
   

  

 For consideration, please submit resume to WIRTGEN INDIA Recruiting:
   

  

 Submit resume

title: Project Manager, Client Connectivity
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

**Business Descriptor**
**Global Payments Solutions**
 Global Payments Solutions is made up of almost 10,000 people, across more than 60 countries. The business is uniquely positioned to help clients make payments across borders, across currencies and regulations, quickly and cost effectively with dedicated in country and regional support. Our expertise in this area is repeatedly recognised by the industry’s most prominent publications and associations with numerous global, regional and country awards.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Global Payments Solutions \- Client Connectivity team.
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities**
 The Project Manager will play a crucial role in contributing to the smooth implementation of cash management solutions. The person will be responsible for onboarding corporate clients onto HSBC’s payment and receivables platform seamlessly.
   

  

 A well\-managed and coordinated implementation captures revenue at the earliest possible time, strengthens the customer relationship and earns long\-term credibility for capturing ongoing business opportunities. The Project Manager shall act as an enabler in achieving this objective.
   

  

**The Role Requires Performing The Below Activities**
* Be responsible for managing Client Implementation / Technical Integration / Solution delivery as well as Servicing of Cash Management solutions (including Payments, Liquidity and Collections) to Corporate Customers (CIB )
* Understand the client's business and act as a consultant to client during the implementation
* Provide consultation to Sales Team and participate in the deal team to secure mandates, including responses to RFI / RFP.
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards, implement and observe Group Compliance Policy and maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring.
* Contribute to the management and development of the Client Connectivity function both in India and the Asia Pacific region and assist to build up GPS Client Connectivity as a cohesive functional unit
* Manage escalations/senior management interventions as also managing operational risk including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting
* Build a relationship across all levels at the customer’s end and become the first point of contact from the bank’s side for any GPS related requirements of the customer requirements rather than a plain transaction banking representative. Ensure top of mind recall with the client
* Be the owner of revenue tracking for clients being onboarded onto HSBC’s platform. Transition management is critical to ensure flows migrate to HSBC counters and revenue starts accruing.
* Work on specific GPS projects covering domestic as well as cross\-border stakeholders.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Project management skills with the ability to manage implementation / client onboarding activities.
* Experience in Client Implementation / Integration for Global Banking and Corporate customers. Technical knowledge in terms of file formats, industry standards etc. are a key requirement.
* Ability to work closely with various teams to deliver comprehensive solutions/services to meet customer needs.
* Experience in Corporate Banking as well as a broad knowledge on the banking, prevailing business environment and regulatory framework are also prerequisites.
* Excellent communication, analytical, negotiation and people oriented skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage challenging customers with a strong customer orientation especially at forging rapport at senior management levels at client's end.
* Interact with multiple internal \& external stake\-holders like GSC, Sales, Services, Customer, Customer Group RM, Legal \& Compliance etc.
* Ability to work under pressure and to think laterally and meet deadlines.
* Take ownership in migrating the wallet share of the client being onboarded from the incumbent bank


**Pro Tip:** 
 Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.
   

  

* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.


 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
   

  

 Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Project Coordinator (Architecture & Interior Project Execution)
description:
**A multidisciplinary architecture and interior design practice in Girgaon, Mumbai is hiring a Project Coordinator with 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in interior fit\-out or architectural project execution.** 

 This is a site\-facing role responsible for coordinating execution, schedules, procurement, documentation, budgets, vendors, contractors and project stakeholders from mobilisation through handover.
 




  





**Project Exposure** 





 The role may involve:
 



* Interior fit\-out and architectural execution
* Residential, hospitality, workplace and retail projects
* Coordination between design development, documentation and site execution
* Procurement, vendor coordination and project delivery



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Conduct regular site visits to monitor progress, workmanship, quality and material availability.
* Maintain daily site updates and project notes using Notion or similar documentation tools.
* Prepare and maintain Gantt charts and project schedules, identify delays and coordinate corrective actions.
* Prepare, review and maintain Bills of Quantities (BOQs) for project requirements.
* Coordinate procurement, including material sourcing, vendor communication, purchase orders and deliveries.
* Maintain site documentation covering material requirements, RFIs, approvals and daily labour or contractor attendance.
* Prepare weekly site visit updates and documentation packages for the Architect, Interior Designer and Studio Director.
* Track project budgets and reconcile expenditure against BOQs and approved requirements.
* Coordinate with contractors, vendors, consultants and clients to resolve execution\-related requirements.
* Coordinate between design information and site requirements to support accurate project execution.
* Maintain project records, schedules, procurement information and site documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
* Monitor site health, safety, cleanliness and general execution conditions.



  





**Requirements** 



* **Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or a related field.**
* **2–3 years of hands\-on experience in interior fit\-out or architectural project execution in a site\-facing role.**
* Experience leading or closely managing at least two projects from mobilisation through handover.
* Strong understanding of architectural execution and site coordination.
* Experience preparing or working with BOQs and site schedules.
* Strong working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets.
* Working proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Notion AI or similar is mandatory, with the ability to use them for documentation, reporting, scheduling or project workflows.
* Demonstrated use of AI to improve project management, scheduling, documentation or site operations is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of Notion is an advantage.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural and interior drawings; AutoCAD or similar software experience is preferred.
* Strong organisational, coordination, problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to independently track project requirements, timelines, documentation and site activities.



  





**Work Schedule** 



* **Location:** 

 Girgaon, Mumbai
* **Working days:** 

 Monday \- Friday (10:30 AM \- 6:30 PM)

description:

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.

 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. * Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting

**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.

title: Change Manager (IT)
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Change Manager (IT)
 
  
 



**Location:** 
 India, Mumbai
 



  
 



 The Agfa\-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business\-to\-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. Agfa strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by combining innovative technology, deep industry expertise, and a strong commitment to quality and sustainability. Agfa’s headquarters are located in Mortsel, Belgium.
 


  About the Role
 
 Agfa is seeking a highly motivated and organized
 **Change Manager** 
 to join its Global IT (Information \& Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will be responsible for governing and coordinating changes across Agfa's global IT landscape, ensuring that modifications to infrastructure, applications, platforms, and services are implemented in a controlled and efficient manner.
 



 You will play a critical role in minimizing business risk and service disruption while maximizing the success rate of IT changes. Working closely with internal stakeholders, managed service providers, and external vendors, you will ensure alignment, compliance, and operational excellence across the change management process.
 


  About You (Skills Required)
 
 You are a strong communicator and coordinator who thrives in a dynamic IT environment. You can balance governance and operational needs while effectively managing multiple stakeholders across different teams and vendors.
 



 You possess:
 


* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Excellent planning, coordination, and organizational capabilities.
* Analytical thinking with a structured approach to risk assessment and problem solving.
* The ability to work effectively across diverse teams, cultures, and external service providers.
* A continuous improvement mindset and focus on service quality.


* Flexibility and willingness to work outside standard business hours to support the planning, coordination, implementation, and governance of critical IT changes in a global 24/7 environment.



  
 



  
 


 What You'll Do (Duties \& Responsibilities)
 * Own and continuously improve the global IT Change Management process.
* Assess, classify, and evaluate changes, including risk and business impact analysis.
* Coordinate and manage changes across multiple vendors and managed service providers.
* Lead Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings and facilitate approval processes, including emergency change procedures.
* Maintain and communicate the 12\-month rolling maintenance calendar.
* Plan, schedule, and coordinate changes across infrastructure, applications, and services.
* Monitor change performance, reporting metrics, and SLA compliance.
* Conduct post\-implementation reviews and drive continuous process improvement initiatives.
* Manage stakeholder communications and change\-related escalations.
* Act as backup for Configuration Management activities when required.


  What You'll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience in IT Service Management or IT Operations environments.
* Strong understanding of Change Management principles and best practices.
* Experience working in outsourced IT environments and managing third\-party service providers.
* Technical background with a solid understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure and application environments.
* Experience with ITIL processes and service management frameworks is highly desirable.
* Ability to work effectively in a global organization with geographically distributed teams.
* Relevant certifications such as ITIL Foundation or ITIL Managing Professional are considered an asset.



  
 



**Why Join Us** 



* Work in a global, multicultural, and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a digital transformation initiatives.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Long\-term learning and career development opportunities.
* Be part of a global IT organization that enables innovation and business success across Agfa worldwide.
* Collaborate with international experts and strategic technology partners.
* Influence and improve key IT governance processes with global impact.



  
 



 If you are passionate about IT Service Management, governance, and driving operational excellence in a global environment, we would love to hear from you. Join Agfa and help shape the future of our global IT services.

title: Lead - Partner Management
description:
**Role Overview** 




 The Lead \- Partner Management will be responsible for governing Tata Croma's service partner ecosystem at a national level to deliver a seamless, scalable, and customer\-centric service experience. The role will drive partner performance, customer satisfaction, service excellence, operational governance, commercial management, and strategic partner development while ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and customer promises.
 



  





 The incumbent will serve as the central leader for partner strategy, onboarding, performance governance, capacity planning, commercial management, process transformation, and customer experience outcomes across all service partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\.
 **Service Partner Strategy \& Governance** 



* Define and execute the national partner management strategy aligned with business, customer experience, and operational objectives.
* Govern the end\-to\-end partner ecosystem, including authorized service centers, logistics partners, installation partners, repair partners, and specialized service providers.
* Establish governance frameworks, review forums, performance scorecards, and escalation mechanisms to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
* Drive strategic partner development initiatives to support future business growth and service transformation.



 2\.
 **Service Delivery \& Customer Experience** 



* Lead end\-to\-end service delivery through partner networks, ensuring achievement of customer experience and service delivery objectives.
* Own customer experience metrics including CSAT, NPS, DSAT, SLA adherence, service quality, ageing complaints, repeat complaints, and escalation management.
* Drive service recovery mechanisms and ensure timely resolution of customer escalations.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and implement corrective action plans in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.



 3\.
 **Partner Performance Management** 



* Establish performance measurement frameworks for all service partners.
* Monitor adherence to contractual commitments, KPIs, SLAs, compliance requirements, and operating standards.
* Conduct periodic business reviews and performance audits.
* Design improvement plans to enhance service quality, productivity, turnaround time, first\-time resolution, and customer satisfaction.



 4\.
 **Partner Selection, RFP \& Onboarding** 



* Lead the complete partner evaluation and onboarding lifecycle.
* Define partner assessment criteria covering operational capability, service coverage, compliance, technology readiness, commercial viability, and customer service capability.
* Manage RFP processes, partner selection, commercial assessments, due diligence, and contract recommendations.
* Ensure successful onboarding and integration of partners into Croma's service ecosystem.



 5\.
 **Commercial \& Financial Management** 



* Manage partner commercials, rate cards, payment governance, penalties, incentives, and financial reconciliations.
* Collaborate with Finance and Procurement teams to ensure commercial compliance and budget adherence.
* Drive productivity and cost optimization initiatives without compromising customer experience.
* Monitor partner billing accuracy, contract obligations, and financial performance.



 6\.
 **Capacity Planning \& Operational Readiness** 



* Ensure adequate partner capacity, manpower deployment, technician availability, and infrastructure readiness across locations.
* Drive demand forecasting and resource planning to support seasonal peaks, business growth, and new service launches.
* Monitor operational readiness and service continuity across all partner locations.



 7\.
 **Continuous Improvement \& Transformation** 



* Lead all service improvement programs across partner operations.
* Identify gaps through customer feedback, VOC, audits, operational reviews, complaint analysis, and partner scorecards.
* Drive process standardization, automation, digitization, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Lead implementation of new operating models, policies, technologies, and customer service processes.



 8\.
 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Stores Operations, Technology, Product, Finance, Marketing, Buying, Supply Chain, HR, Training, and Customer Experience teams.
* Support design and deployment of customer service journeys for new products, services, subscription plans, and service propositions.
* Ensure operational alignment across all stakeholders impacting customer experience.



 9\.
 **Risk, Compliance \& Control** 



* Identify and mitigate operational, financial, compliance, partner, and customer experience risks.
* Ensure adherence to organizational policies, statutory requirements, audit controls, and service governance frameworks.
* Drive corrective actions arising from audits and compliance reviews.
* Develop business continuity plans for partner operations.
* Drive a culture of accountability, customer centricity, ownership, and continuous improvement.



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Management, Operations, Customer Service, or related discipline.
* MBA/Post\-Graduate qualification preferred.



  





**Experience** 



* 12\-18 years of experience in Service Operations, Partner Management, Customer Experience, Vendor Management, or After\-Sales Service.
* Minimum 5 years in a leadership role managing large\-scale partner ecosystems across multiple geographies.
* Exposure to Consumer Durables, Retail, Telecom, E\-commerce, Technology, Automotive, or Service Industries preferred.
* Proven experience in managing RFPs, partner onboarding, service governance, commercial negotiations, and operational transformation programs.

title: Project Manager - International Wealth Management
description:
**Role Overview** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the delivery of key initiatives within the International Wealth Management (IWM) program. The successful candidate will combine strong programme/project management discipline with deep knowledge of investment products and the IWM operating model — coordinating business, technology, vendor, and control\-function stakeholders to deliver complex change across multiple functions and locations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ◼ Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of IWM program workstreams — developing detailed project plans, maintaining RAID logs, and managing scope, schedule, budget, and dependencies.
 



 ◼ Prioritize delivery based on business impact, regulatory requirements, and operational risk, ensuring alignment with the IWM target operating model.
 



 ◼ Coordinate across multiple teams — business, technology, vendors, and control functions — to drive execution and timely resolution of issues.
 



 ◼ Apply strong product knowledge to steer scope and design decisions across the investment product lifecycle (asset capture, order and lifecycle management, settlements, and client/regulatory reporting obligations).
 



 ◼ Establish and maintain project management standards, processes, and best practices to ensure efficient, consistent delivery.
 



 ◼ Proactively identify and manage risks and issues that may affect project health, escalating with clear mitigation strategies.
 



 ◼ Provide regular updates to IWM leadership, working groups, and steering committees on progress, delivery metrics, risks, dependencies, and mitigation status.
 



 ◼ Conduct post\-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement.
 



  





**Skills, experience, qualifications and knowledge required:** 




  





 ◼ Previous experience working within Wealth Management (International/Private Banking preferred), Wholesale Banking, or Asset Management.
 



 ◼ Strong understanding of the International Wealth Management landscape, including client segments, advisory/discretionary models, and the front\-to\-back operating model.
 



 ◼ Strong knowledge of financial products (e.g., derivatives, structured products, funds) with hands\-on exposure to the investment product lifecycle — from asset capture and order/lifecycle management through settlements and client/regulatory reporting.
 



 ◼ Exposure to Capital Markets, Managed Investments, and Private Assets product lifecycles.
 



 ◼ Proven experience managing transformation initiatives — creating project plans, maintaining RAID logs, and working across multiple functions in the firm.
 



 ◼ Strong experience engaging cross\-functional domain SMEs, Business Management, and Control Functions (Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax).
 



 ◼ Expertise in conceptual modelling — able to see the big picture, envision solution options, and provide concise, precise, managerial answers across a wide range of business topics.
 



 ◼ Ability to engage stakeholders at all levels of seniority and manage cross\-functional projects
 



 ◼ Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex problems simply to drive quick, effective decisionmaking.
 



 ◼ Previous experience with Jira, Confluence, Power BI, or similar tools.
 



 ◼ Ability to work under limited supervision (a "self\-starter") in unstructured environments
 



 ◼ Intellectual strength and flexibility to rapidly understand complex problems and rationalize them into deliverable solutions.
 



 ◼ High level of drive, commitment to outcomes, and ability to work under pressure
 



 ◼ Familiarity with different delivery methodologies (particularly Agile)
 



 ◼ Experience working with technology teams to deliver complex solutions across multiple business areas, functions, and locations.
 



  





  





**Desirable** 




 ◼ Hands\-on exposure to the Avaloq Core Platform
 



 ◼ Project Management Certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2\)
 



 ◼ Familiarity articulating requirements in the form of Use Cases and User Stories

title: Data Program Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 Zensar Technologies Limited is seeking a seasoned Data Program Manager to own the Phoenix Data Workstream, a critical component of a multi‑year Oracle ERP, EPM, and finance transformation. The role will act as the single point of accountability for planning, governance, delivery coordination, risk management, stakeholder engagement and vendor oversight, ensuring a controlled, governed data landscape that enables business transformation across Finance, Technology, Reporting, Architecture, Change, Oracle and KPMG teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the Data Workstream across the full programme lifecycle, developing and maintaining an integrated workstream plan.
* Oversee end‑to‑end data migration strategy, sequencing, execution, and reconciliation, including cleansing, ETL and cut‑over activities.
* Establish and maintain Enterprise Data Management (EDM) as the single source of truth, driving master data governance and stewardship.
* Coordinate downstream reporting and analytics readiness, managing impacts of chart of accounts, organisational structures and finance process redesign.
* Drive implementation of the Phoenix Data Strategy and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and ODP/Data Platform integration.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with executive sponsors, finance leaders, technology and architecture teams, Oracle, KPMG and downstream application owners.
* Manage delivery activities performed by KPMG and Oracle, challenging estimates and ensuring contractual deliverables meet quality standards.
* Maintain RAID logs, prepare governance packs for SteerCo/ExCo, and produce regular status, risk and issue reports.
* Track workstream budget, forecasts and financial commitments, ensuring alignment with programme financial controls.
* Facilitate workshops, design reviews and governance forums, escalating issues and decisions in a timely manner.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of project or programme management experience, preferably in large‑scale Oracle ERP transformations.
* Proven experience leading data migration workstreams and enterprise data governance initiatives.
* Strong understanding of finance transformation programmes and chart of accounts redesign.
* Demonstrated ability to manage global stakeholder groups and multi‑vendor environments.
* Experience working within complex, matrixed organisations and delivering against tight timelines.
* Oracle ERP Cloud delivery experience (highly desirable).
* Hands‑on experience with Oracle EDM and FCCS (highly desirable).
* Experience implementing ODP or enterprise data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric (highly desirable).
* Financial Services industry background (highly desirable).
* Excellent communication, negotiation and risk mitigation skills.

title: Assistant Manager – Graduate Program Manager, Technology
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Assistant Manager – Graduate Program Manager, Technology
   

  

**Department** 
 : Human Resources
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 Human Resources
   

  

**Position Purpose**
* The role will be responsible for the end\-to\-end program management and experience of Technology Interns and Graduate hires, from onboarding through their development journey and rotations until they transition into their permanent Technology roles.
* The role will typically manage a participant journey of approximately 18 months, ensuring a structured, consistent and high\-quality experience across Technology verticals.


**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Own the complete lifecycle of Technology Interns and Graduates, including onboarding, induction, training, rotations, performance and productivity management, compensation processes and eventual transition into permanent roles.
* Develop and maintain the overall program calendar, milestones, governance and operating rhythm across the approximately 18\-month graduate journey.
* Ensure consistent execution of the program across different Technology businesses and locations while accommodating relevant business\-specific requirements.
* Design and coordinate a strong onboarding and induction experience, ensuring participants understand the organization, Technology landscape, culture, expectations and career opportunities.
* Maintain regular engagement with participants, identify experience gaps and proactively address issues that could affect development, performance or retention.
* Build a strong sense of cohort and community across the intern and graduate population.
* Partner with Technology SMEs and Learning teams to ensure the curriculum remains relevant to evolving Technology capabilities and business requirements.


 Rotation Management
   

  

* Manage graduate rotations across Technology verticals, working closely with business leaders and HRBPs to identify suitable assignments.
* Track participant performance and development across rotations and facilitate effective handovers between managers.
* Establish a structured performance\-management framework for interns and graduates, including objectives, regular feedback, performance reviews and development interventions.
* Track productivity and readiness indicators as participants progress through the program. Work with managers to address performance gaps and ensure appropriate development actions are implemented.


 Stakeholder \& Leadership Engagement
   

  

* Build strong relationships across Technology verticals and act as the principal program interface with Technology leaders, managers, HRBPs and HR COEs.
* Create structured opportunities for senior leaders to interact with the cohorts and provide input into their development.
* Provide leadership with clear dashboards and updates covering program progress, participant performance, experience, retention and key risks.


 Compensation \& Program Governance
   

  

* Coordinate compensation and other relevant people process for interns and graduates in partnership with Compensation \& Benefits and HR teams.
* Ensure consistent application of program principles, policies and governance across Technology verticals.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong program and project management capability


**Specific Qualifications**
* Preference for Engineering degree strongly and an understanding of Technology disciplines and the ability to engage effectively with Technology stakeholders.
* Approximately 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably including exposure to one or more of the following: HR Business Partnering within a Technology organization / Graduate / Early Careers Program Management / Compensation \& Benefits / Learning and talent development


**Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**
* Ability to manage multiple cohorts, stakeholders and milestones simultaneously
* Good understanding of the Technology environment and technology talent
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to engage credibly with senior Technology leaders
* Understanding of core HR processes including performance, compensation, learning and talent management
* Strong analytical capability and comfort working with program and workforce data
* Excellent communication, facilitation and presentation skills
* Ability to work across organizational boundaries and influence without direct authority


**Education Level:** 
 MBA / postgraduate qualification in Human Resources preferred.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Mumbai

title: Project Manager, IME
description:
**The Opportunity**
 Our client is looking for an experienced
 **Project Manager** 
 to lead and coordinate multiple projects across the full delivery lifecycle within a fast\-paced consumer goods environment.
   

  

 This role will take ownership of projects from initial scope and planning through execution and delivery, ensuring key initiatives are completed
 **on time, within scope and aligned with business objectives** 
 . The successful candidate will work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders including Marketing, R\&D, Quality, Regulatory, Engineering and external partners.
   

  

**About the Company**
 Our client is a well\-established global
 **consumer packaged goods (CPG) company** 
 with a diversified portfolio of household, personal care, health and wellness products.
   

 With products distributed across more than 100 countries and an expanding international presence, the organisation offers an entrepreneurial and performance\-driven environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership and contribute to the growth of established consumer brands.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**End\-to\-End Project Management**
* Own and manage multiple projects across the complete project lifecycle, from planning through execution and delivery.
* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, milestones, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Drive project execution while ensuring delivery against agreed timelines, budgets, scope and quality standards.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify and manage risks, issues and dependencies.
* Manage project changes and ensure continued alignment on scope, priorities and business objectives.



**Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Serve as the central point of coordination across functions involved in project delivery.
* Partner closely with Marketing, R\&D, Quality, Regulatory, Engineering, business teams and external vendors.
* Align stakeholders around project priorities, timelines, responsibilities and deliverables.
* Identify and resolve cross\-functional blockers, conflicts and dependencies.
* Facilitate effective communication between technical and non\-technical stakeholders.



**Project Governance \& Stakeholder Management**
* Establish effective project governance and maintain clear visibility of project status and deliverables.
* Prepare regular project reports, dashboards and executive updates.
* Facilitate project meetings, planning sessions, reviews and other relevant project\-management forums.

* Experience of having worked in an onsite\- offshore delivery model
* Project Management experience should be of leading at least a team of 10\-15 members
* Experience with leading business blueprint, gathering and documenting business requirements and designing SAP enabled solutions
* Experience facilitating cross\-functional team members with complex schedules against a published plan
* Development of project documentation including business process flows, training materials, requirements gathering and project management methodology experience required
* Experience should be in End\-to\-end Implementation, Rollout, Support, upgrade, enhancements in the below areas.
* 
+ SAP Finance – FI\- New General Ledger \& Profit Center Accounting, FI\-Accounts Payable, FI\-Bank accounting and FI\-Asset Accounting.
+ Exposure on SAP Simple Finance – GL Accounting, Asset Accounting and CO – Overhead Cost Controlling \& Profitability Analysis.
+ SAP Finance – Taxation and Withholding Taxes.
+ SAP Finance – Closing activities, Validations and Substitutions \& Reporting.
+ Controlling\- CO\-Cost element accounting CO\-Cost Center Accounting and CO\-Internal Orders.
+ Knowledge on CO\-PA \& Product Costing (Planning and cost object controlling).
+ FI integration with MM, SD, HR \& PS.
+ Excellent business communication skills
+ Experience on FIORI APPS, BO\-DS, BW, HANA and other reporting tools


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

title: Change Manager
description:
Experience : 8\+ Years
 



 Location : Mumbai
 



  





**About the Role:** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced Technical Change Manager to support a large\-scale Salesforce Revenue Cloud implementation. This role will be part of the PMO and will be responsible for coordinating technical changes, release activities, business approvals, deployment readiness, and production releases.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong experience managing enterprise application releases, coordinating across business and technology teams, obtaining required sign\-offs, and driving Go/No\-Go decisions for production deployments.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 • Own the Change Management and Release Management process for the Salesforce Revenue Cloud program.
 



 • Work as part of the PMO, coordinating closely with Program Managers, Business Leads, Salesforce teams, QA, DevOps, Support, and other technology teams.
 



 • Coordinate and track all technical changes associated with Salesforce releases.
 



 • Ensure appropriate business approvals and sign\-offs are obtained before production deployment.
 



 • Maintain release plans, deployment schedules, change calendars, dependencies, and readiness checkpoints.
 



 • Coordinate release activities across Development, QA, UAT, Production, and supporting systems.
 



 • Validate that required testing, UAT approvals, production readiness, rollback plans, and support plans are completed before release.
 



 • Lead Go/No\-Go calls and facilitate release readiness discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
 



 • Document decisions, risks, issues, dependencies, and action items from Go/No\-Go meetings.
 



 • Coordinate production deployment activities and ensure all participating teams understand their responsibilities and timelines.
 



 • Manage emergency changes, planned releases, hot fixes, and production change requests.
 



 • Coordinate releases involving Salesforce and integrated upstream/downstream enterprise applications.
 



 • Track release risks and escalate issues that could impact deployment timelines or business operations.
 



 • Ensure changes follow established Change Management, Release Management, and governance processes.
 



 • Coordinate post\-deployment validation, production verification, and business confirmation.
 



 • Facilitate post\-release reviews and capture lessons learned for future releases.
 



 • Provide release and change status reporting to PMO and senior stakeholders.
 



 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 • 7\+ years of experience in Technical Change Management, Release Management, Program Management, or Technical PMO roles.
 



 • Strong experience managing enterprise application releases and production deployments.
 



 • Experience supporting Salesforce implementations, preferably Salesforce Revenue Cloud, CPQ, Billing, or Quote\-to\-Cash programs.
 



 • Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, testing, UAT, production deployment, and release governance.
 



 • Experience running Go/No\-Go meetings and production readiness reviews.
 



 • Strong experience obtaining and managing business, technology, QA, and operational sign\-offs.
 



 • Ability to coordinate multiple technical and business teams across complex releases.
 



 • Experience managing release calendars, dependencies, risks, issues, and deployment checklists.
 



 • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
 



 • Experience working within a PMO governance structure.
 



 • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Salesforce DevOps tools, or similar platforms.
 



  





**Preferred Experience:** 




 • Salesforce Revenue Cloud / Revenue Cloud Advanced
 



 • Salesforce CPQ and Billing
 



 • Quote\-to\-Cash / Lead\-to\-Cash processes
 



 • Salesforce integrations with ERP, Finance, Billing, CRM, and downstream systems
 



 • ITIL Change and Release Management
 



 • CI/CD and Salesforce deployment processes
 



 • Large enterprise transformation programs
 



  





**Key Focus Areas:** 




 This is not a traditional Organizational Change Management / communications role. The primary focus is technical change governance, release coordination, production readiness, business sign\-offs, and execution of enterprise Salesforce releases.
 



 The Technical Change Manager will serve as the central coordination point between the PMO, Business, Salesforce delivery teams, QA, DevOps, and Production Support to ensure every release is properly approved, controlled, communicated, and successfully deployed.

title: Assistant Manager - Client Solutions
description:
**About Nextyn:** 




 Nextyn is a fast\-growing expert network company that enables clients worldwide to connect with industry experts for research, consulting, and strategic decision\-making.
 



 With a growing global presence, we work with clients across geographies and industries, helping them access high\-quality expert insights to support critical business and investment decisions.
 



 Role Summary
 



  





 As an
 **Assistant Manager – Client Solutions** 
 , you will manage key client relationships while leading a team of Associates/Analysts responsible for delivering high\-quality expert research and engagement.
 



  





 The role combines
 **client relationship management, team leadership, expert identification, project delivery, and account growth** 
 . You will be responsible for understanding client requirements, ensuring timely and high\-quality execution, developing your team, and identifying opportunities to strengthen and grow client accounts.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Client Relationship Management
 


* Own end\-to\-end relationships with a portfolio of key clients and understand their research objectives, priorities, and evolving requirements.
* Act as the primary point of contact for client queries, escalations, and project\-related discussions.
* Build strong, long\-term relationships that support client retention and account growth.
* Maintain a high level of responsiveness and ensure a consistent client experience across engagements.



 2\. Team Management \& Development
 


* Recruit, onboard, train, and develop Associates/Analysts within the Client Solutions team.
* Set clear goals and expectations and monitor individual and team performance.
* Provide regular coaching, feedback, and support to help team members build their client management, research, and expert engagement capabilities.
* Build a high\-performing team that can independently manage projects and deliver against client expectations.



 3\. Expert Identification \& Engagement
 


* Oversee the identification, evaluation, and engagement of relevant industry experts for client requirements.
* Guide the team on expert sourcing strategies and quality evaluation criteria.
* Ensure experts identified are relevant, credible, and aligned with the client's research objectives.
* Take ownership of specialized, complex, or high\-priority expert searches when required.



 4\. Account Growth \& Revenue
 


* Own revenue targets for assigned accounts and work towards achieving account growth objectives.
* Identify opportunities for upselling, cross\-selling, and expanding relationships across client accounts.
* Track account performance and proactively highlight potential risks and growth opportunities to leadership.
* Support client proposals, pricing discussions, and commercial conversations where required.



 5\. Project Coordination \& Delivery
 


* Oversee the timely and high\-quality execution of projects managed by the team.
* Coordinate with internal teams including Research, Operations, and Compliance to resolve project\-related bottlenecks.
* Monitor turnaround times, project progress, and quality standards across active engagements.
* Step in where required to resolve critical issues and ensure client commitments are met.



 6\. Research \& Insights
 


* Guide the team on qualitative and quantitative research approaches based on client requirements.
* Review and validate research outputs, expert profiles, and market insights before client delivery.
* Develop a strong understanding of relevant industries and market trends to support client conversations and internal decision\-making.
* Use research and market insights to identify relevant experts and strengthen project outcomes.



  





 Qualifications \& Skills
 



 Education
 


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Management, or a related field.



  





 Experience
 


* 2–5 years of relevant experience in expert networks, client management, account management, research, consulting, or a similar client\-facing environment.
* Prior experience managing or mentoring a team is preferred.
* Experience in expert networks, market research, consulting, or professional services will be an advantage.



  





 Skills
 


* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong client and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proven ability to manage, coach, and develop a team.
* Strong analytical, research, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good business judgment and the ability to understand client requirements.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts, projects, and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively under deadlines.



  





 Location \& Joining
 


* **Location:** 
 Mumbai
* **Work Model:** 
 Work from Office
* **Preference:** 
 Immediate joiners preferred



  





 What Nextyn Offers
 


* Work\-from\-office environment with structured working hours.
* Opportunity to work with global clients and senior industry experts.
* Leadership exposure through team management and account ownership.
* Opportunities to build expertise across industries and develop strong client\-facing capabilities.
* Learning and career growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling organization.
* Competitive compensation and benefits, including PF and insurance.

description:

  Demand Planner: Predict future product demand, create demand forecasts, and align supply chain activities with market needs.   Risk Management: Identify potential risks and vulnerabilities in the supply chain such as supply shortages, supplier disruptions, regulatory changes and geopolitical issues. Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies to address challenges and business continuity.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
Senior Manager \- Technical Diligence \& Project Controls \| Vantrock Real Assets \| Mumbai
 



  





 WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
 



  





 Read a site badly at diligence and the error is baked into the underwriting for the life of the asset. Read it well and the deal either improves or dies early, the cheapest outcome available. The same scepticism, pointed at a contractor's programme, tells you whether the date on it is real. Pointed at a running bill, it tells you whether we are paying for work that exists.
 



  





 Vantrock currently buys all of that judgement from consultants, one assignment at a time, with nobody inside who can mark their work. The pipeline is 10 million sq ft and ground breaks on the first 2 million in January 2027\. From that point the platform is running acquisitions and construction at once, and whoever can walk a site in the morning and take apart a Primavera file in the afternoon becomes the most useful person in the room.
 



  





 This is the technical seat in the Enterprise Programme Management Office. The other two seats hold the portfolio and the governance. You hold the ground truth underneath both, and you hold it across the whole life of an asset rather than at one gate.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




  





 Before we buy
 



 \- Technical pre\-diligence on every site under consideration. Ground, levels and cut\-fill, approach and access, power availability and distance to source, water, drainage and outfall, existing structures, and every physical constraint that changes what can be built there. Your output goes into the underwriting as a technical view with the assumptions stated.
 



 \- The buildability and cost\-shape read. Not a BOQ, a judgement: what makes this site expensive and where the foundation cost goes. Early, rough and honest beats late and precise.
 



 \- Development potential against the authority's rules. What MIDC, HSIIDC, KIADB or the local DCR actually permit on this parcel, and what that does to the yield the model assumes.
 



  





**While we design and build** 




 \- Design and specification review. Read what the architect and the consultants propose against what actually builds, and against the Vantrock specification, before it becomes a tender.
 



 \- Tender and rate scrutiny. Rate analysis, comparative statements and the technical read on a bid. You can look at a rate and say whether it is real.
 



 \- Programme review and claims. Take apart the contractor's and the PMC's programmes on critical path, float, sequencing and resource loading, and report what is real. Assess extension\-of\-time claims on their technical merits. A programme that has never been challenged is a wish.
 



 \- Technical validation on site. Running bills, measurement, quality and progress against the drawings. What you certify is technical. The money is finance's, and the two of you reconcile weekly.
 



  





**Through handover and after** 




 \- The technical close\-out. Snagging, defect liability, warranties and the as\-built record, so the asset arrives at operations in a state somebody can run.
 



 \- The occupier's technical requirements. Floor loading, flatness, power, fire and insurer conditions, read against what the building gives, so leasing and the tenant's fit\-out are not negotiating against a surprise.
 



 \- The physical record. Site visits captured properly and put into Vantrock Intelligence, so the platform's memory of a site does not live in one person's phone.
 



  





**Across all of it** 




 \- Command of technical partners. Geotechnical agencies, surveyors, TDD firms, third\-party inspection and PMCs. You brief them, hold them to a standard and mark their output. You never take a report on trust because it arrived on letterhead.
 



  





 THE CAREER SHAPE, AND THIS ONE IS NOT NEGOTIABLE
 



  





 We are looking for a specific arc, in a specific order. You started on the developer's or the contractor's side. You carried responsibility on a site, and you know what a delay costs because you have been the person who had to explain it. Then you moved into technical due diligence, lender's independent engineer, technical audit or project monitoring, where you learned to structure a problem, write for an executive and hold more than one project in your head at a time.
 



  





 The order matters more than either half. Someone who has only ever consulted writes a view that nobody on the ground respects, because it asks for things a site cannot give. Someone who has only ever been on site can hold a project but not a portfolio. We want depth first and structure second, and we want both.
 



  





 Bring the first half in detail. We will ask which sites, what your scope was, what the ground turned out to be and what it cost to deal with.
 



  





 QUALIFICATION
 



  





 \- A full\-time B.E. or B.Tech in Civil Engineering. This one is not negotiable and no other discipline substitutes.
 



 \- A postgraduate qualification is a strong plus rather than a requirement: NICMAR (ACM, APM or the QSCM diploma), RICS School of Built Environment, an IIT or NIT M.Tech in structural, geotechnical or construction engineering, and the NMIMS MBA (Tech.) in Civil Engineering with Operations Management. An MBA in Finance, a CFA or CA is an added advantage. Chartered or professional standing \- MRICS, Institution of Engineers (India), a valuer's registration, IGBC or LEED \- is read as evidence that you write to a standard someone else audits.
 



  





 TECHNICAL GROUNDING \- ESSENTIAL
 



  





 This is the part of the seat that cannot be learned on the job here, so we will test it directly, on a real drawing set and a real soil report.
 



  





 \- Ground and land form. Borelogs, SPT data, safe bearing capacity, settlement, water table, ground\-improvement options and what each one costs. Contours, cut and fill, approach gradients, and survey output read rather than taken on trust. You know what to specify to a geotechnical agency before they mobilise.
 



 \- Codes and authorities. IS 456, 800, 875 and 1893, the National Building Code, and the development control and industrial authority rules that bind a site.
 



 \- Warehousing and industrial specifics. Pre\-engineered buildings, portal frames, purlins and bracing, crane gantries, floor loading and flatness to the occupier's standard, fire strategy and sprinkler implications on the layout, and what an insurer's engineering requirements do to a design.
 



 \- Services and enabling. HT power, sanctioned load, distance to substation and what the discom will and will not do. Water source, sewage treatment, storm water outfall and where it legally goes.
 



 \- Cost. BOQ, rate analysis, running account bills, variation orders, escalation, retention and defect liability.
 



 \- Programme. Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project at critical\-path, float and resource\-loading level, with extension\-of\-time claims assessed on merit. Essential in this seat specifically, because reading a programme against physical reality is the job.
 



 \- Drawings. GFC review, structural and services coordination, and BIM clash detection at a level where you know what the model is hiding.
 



 \- Writing. A technical report a lender's credit committee or an investment committee can act on: findings, assumptions, quantified impact and a recommendation you will stand behind. Plus advanced Excel and PowerPoint.
 



 \- Platforms. Microsoft Project at working level, plus a background working in SAP, Primavera P6 or Project Online. We will ask which one, what you did in it and what it could not do.
 



  





 RELEVANT EXPERIENCE
 



  





 \- 8 to 12 years, the majority of it on or around sites rather than in a design office.
 



 \- At least three years on technical due diligence, independent engineer, technical audit or project monitoring work. Not delivery with a diligence assignment attached once.
 



 \- Sites assessed across greenfield land and built assets both. Assessing only completed buildings is half the seat.
 



 \- A report a lender, an investment committee or a buyer relied on to price or to walk away, and which held up afterwards.
 



 \- One constraint you found that nobody else had, and what it changed. This is the question the whole interview turns on.
 



 \- Specialist agencies instructed and marked, not merely coordinated.
 



  





 WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT
 



  





 \- Not delivery or EPC, and not design. Execution is owned elsewhere and that seat is filled. You review what is proposed, you do not draw it and you do not build to it.
 



 \- Not the deal, and not portfolio governance. Investments owns underwriting and the register sits with the EPMO Lead. You supply the technical view into both, and you are expected to supply it even when it kills the deal.
 



 \- Not project accounting. Budget, forecast and variance sit with finance.
 



  





 HOW YOU WILL WORK
 



  





 Deliberately small, no departments. Survey, soil investigation, third\-party inspection and measurement all go to specialist agencies. What stays inside is the judgement about whether their work is any good and what it means for the money. Expect to be on site most weeks, and expect your written view to be read by the founder, the investment committee and, in time, by lenders.
 



  





 THE WORK IS YOURS TO DO
 



  





 We are not building an army. You do the work rather than receive it, route it and report on it. You walk the site yourself, brief the geotechnical agency yourself, take the drone output apart yourself and write the report in your own hand. You run your own tech stack rather than specifying it for someone else. Seniority changes what you are accountable for, not whether you roll up your sleeves.

title: CX Program Manager, APAC
description:

 Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super\-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200\+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in\-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
   

  

 Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the CX Program Manager for APAC, you will be the primary connection point between Customer Experience and the broader business. You will ensure CX teams are informed, prepared, and operationally ready for customer\-impacting initiatives across the APAC region.
   

  

 You will be the regional subject matter expert for launches, promotions, product changes, content releases, market expansion initiatives, and other business developments that may impact Customer Experience. You will gather information from multiple departments, assess customer support impacts, coordinate readiness activities, and ensure Customer Experience teams have the information they need to deliver exceptional customer experiences. You will advocate for the Customer Experience team by providing feedback and input to influence decisions and ensuring that you represent the CX perspective.
   

  

 In the role of CX Program Manager, APAC, you will report to the Senior Manager, CX Enablement.
   

  

 We are considering applicants for the location of Mumbai, India.
   

  

 Core Areas of Responsibility
   

  

 Launch Readiness \& Program Management
   

  

* Oversee end\-to\-end Customer Experience launch readiness for APAC customer\-impacting initiatives.
* Coordinate launch planning and readiness activities for promotions, product launches, content releases, platform changes, market expansions, and other business\-critical initiatives.
* Develop and maintain launch timelines, readiness plans, risk assessments, and action trackers.
* Ensure Customer Experience teams are informed, prepared, and aligned ahead of launches.
* Facilitate launch readiness reviews and drive accountability across stakeholders.
* Lead post\-launch retrospectives and continuous improvement initiatives.


 Stakeholder Management \& Communication
   

  

* Be the primary Customer Experience representative for APAC initiatives.
* Build strong partnerships with Product, Marketing, Commerce, Content, Legal, Operations, Localization, and other cross\-departmental teams.
* Maintain proactive communication with regional stakeholders to identify upcoming initiatives and business changes.
* Represent Customer Experience in meetings outside the CX organization and advocate for CX team needs.
* Establish yourself as a trusted advisor and extension of Customer Experience for regional stakeholders.
* Ensure critical information is communicated clearly, consistently, and at the right time.


 Customer Experience Impact Assessment
   

  

* Evaluate upcoming initiatives and determine potential impacts to Customer Experience operations.
* Identify customer support risks, operational dependencies, process implications, and training requirements.
* Challenge assumptions and critically assess information to ensure CX receives the most relevant and actionable insights.
* Escalate risks and recommend mitigation strategies when needed.
* Advocate for the customer and agent experience throughout launch planning and execution.


 Insights, Analytics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Lead launch retrospectives and post\-launch reviews.
* Review support trends, and customer insights to improve launch preparedness
* Identify cross\-team opportunities to improve launch readiness, stakeholder communication, and operational execution.
* Track launch outcomes and recommend improvements based on data\-driven insights.
* Contribute to the evolution of Customer Experience program management best practices globally.


 Documentation \& Operational Excellence
   

  

* Maintain clear and concise launch documentation, readiness plans, meeting notes, and project artifacts.
* Manage regional planning boards and program tracking tools (e.g., Asana).
* Ensure decisions, risks, dependencies, and action items are properly documented and communicated.
* Drive operational consistency and continuous process improvement across Customer Experience programs.


**About You**
 We get excited about candidates like you, because...

**About Springer Nature**

Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology\-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.


**About the Brand**

Springer Health\+, part of the Springer Nature Group, is a global leader in healthcare education and communications. We partner with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare organizations to develop evidence\-based scientific communications, medical education initiatives, publications, and strategic Medical Affairs solutions that improve healthcare decision\-making and patient outcomes.


**About the Role**

The Manager \- Scientific Services \- will lead the development and delivery of high\-quality scientific communications and Medical Affairs initiatives for pharmaceutical and healthcare clients.


The role requires a blend of scientific expertise, project leadership, stakeholder engagement, and commercial acumen to deliver impactful solutions and support the growth of Springer Health\+'s Scientific Services business in India.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Scientific Content \& Medical Communications**

* Develop evidence\-based scientific content by leveraging strong Pharmaceutical Industry Knowledge and Product and Service Knowledge to ensure relevance, accuracy, and scientific rigor.

* Develop scientific platforms, advisory board materials, slide decks, publications, manuscripts, literature reviews, and medical education assets that effectively support client objectives and therapeutic communication needs.
* Conduct literature searches, evidence assessments, and scientific analyses utilizing deep Pharmaceutical Industry Knowledge and critical evaluation skills.
* Ensure scientific accuracy, quality, and compliance across deliverables while balancing regulatory requirements, business goals, and stakeholder expectations through effective Stakeholder Management.

**Medical Affairs \& Client Engagement**

* Partner with Medical Affairs teams to support strategic scientific objectives while effectively Balancing Stakeholders and fostering cross\-functional collaboration.
* Participate in client meetings, advisory boards, and scientific discussions by applying Consultative Selling techniques and demonstrating strong scientific expertise.

**KOL Engagement**

**Project Leadership**

* Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation plans proactively to ensure successful project execution and stakeholder satisfaction.

**Business Growth**

* Support proposals, capability presentations, and client pitches by combining scientific expertise with Consultative Selling, Business Development, and Product and Service Knowledge.
* Identify growth opportunities within existing and new accounts through a strong understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, and business objectives.
* Provide scientific input during project scoping and planning, incorporating Financial Acumen and strategic business considerations to support successful project outcomes.
* Contribute to business expansion efforts by maintaining a customer\-centric approach and identifying opportunities to enhance service offerings and client value.

**Compliance \& Quality**

* Ensure adherence to industry regulations, ethical standards, and company processes by applying comprehensive Pharmaceutical Industry Knowledge and quality\-focused practices.
* Participate in quality assurance and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational excellence, client satisfaction, and service quality.

**Team Development**

* Mentor junior team members and contribute to scientific training programs by sharing expertise in scientific communications, therapeutic areas, and industry best practices.
* Promote knowledge sharing, collaboration, and scientific excellence while fostering a **C** ustomer\-Focused, Action\-Oriented, and high\-performance team culture.
* Support the development of team capabilities related to Pharmaceutical Industry Knowledge, Product and Service Knowledge, stakeholder management, and business acumen.

**Experience \& Qualifications**

**Education**

· MBBS, MD, PharmD, M.Pharm, PhD, Life Sciences, or related healthcare qualification.


· Additional qualifications in Medical Affairs, Medical Writing, Publications, or Management are advantageous.


**Experience**

· 8\-10 years' experience in Medical Communications, Medical Affairs, Scientific Services, or Healthcare Communications.


· Proven expertise in scientific content development and client engagement.


· Strong understanding of clinical research, evidence evaluation, and publication practices.


· Familiarity with GPP2022, ICMJE, AMA style, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements.


· Experience in leading expert consensus panels and managing structured scientific consensus initiatives.


· Knowledge of real\-world evidence generation, with hands\-on experience conducting real\-world studies end to end.


Technical Expertise


· Medical Affairs and scientific communication strategy.


· Advisory boards, publications, medical education, and scientific content development.


· Publication planning and evidence generation.


· Pharmaceutical compliance and regulatory awareness.


· Exposure to digital and AI\-enabled scientific communication solutions is desirable.


**Key Skills \& Leadership Competencies**

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:


· Strategic Thinking: Translates scientific evidence and client needs into actionable solutions.


· Agility \& Adaptability: Thrives in fast\-paced environments and manages changing priorities effectively.


· Analytical Thinking: Connects disparate information and derives meaningful insights.


· Curiosity \& Innovation: Explores emerging science, technologies, and AI\-enabled opportunities.


· Communication \& Influence: Effectively engages Medical Affairs leaders, KOLs, and cross\-functional teams.


· Collaboration \& Leadership: Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and the ability to mentor and inspire others.


· Commercial Acumen: Balances scientific rigor with business objectives and identifies growth opportunities.

The successful candidate will combine scientific excellence, strategic thinking, agility, and strong stakeholder management to deliver impactful solutions that create value for clients and support the growth of Springer Health\+'s Scientific Services business

title: Technology & Security Project Manager
description:
**Role Overview** 




 This is a site\-embedded SME role focused on the specific ELV, BMS, and security infrastructure of a designated data centre campus or facility. Unlike the portfolio\-level SME role, this position requires deep, facility\-specific technical knowledge — the as\-built configuration, site\-specific control logic, vendor systems in use, and local operational constraints of the assigned site — to provide hands\-on technical support to site operations, construction, and commissioning teams.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the on\-site/site\-dedicated technical point of contact for all ELV, BMS, and security system matters at the assigned facility.
* Maintain detailed, current knowledge of the site's as\-built ELV and BMS architecture, including device inventory, network topology, controller configurations, and integration points with EPMS and fire/life\-safety systems.
* Support live\-site troubleshooting of ELV, BMS, and security system faults, coordinating with OEM vendors and facility operations/NOC teams for rapid resolution.
* Review and validate site\-specific change requests (MOPs/EOPs) affecting ELV, BMS, or security systems before implementation.
* Provide technical walkdown support during audits, client inspections, and compliance reviews specific to the site.
* Support site commissioning and re\-commissioning activities for ELV, BMS, and security systems during capacity expansions, retrofits, or system upgrades.
* Maintain and update site\-specific documentation — as\-built drawings, points lists, network diagrams, and system configuration baselines — reflecting all field changes.
* Coordinate with the portfolio\-level ELV \& Security SME on design standard alignment, escalations, and lessons learned across sites.
* Support incident response and root\-cause investigations for site\-specific ELV/BMS/security events, including data gathering, log review, and vendor coordination.
* Train and guide site facility/operations personnel on ELV and BMS system operation, alarm handling, and basic troubleshooting.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 8–12 years of experience in ELV and BMS systems, with demonstrated experience providing hands\-on, site\-level technical support in a live/operational data centre environment.
* Working knowledge of the specific BMS/EPMS platform(s) deployed at the assigned site (e.g., Niagara/Tridium, Schneider EcoStruxure, Siemens Desigo, Honeywell, Johnson Controls Metasys).
* Practical experience with CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, and PA systems as deployed and configured on an operational site.
* Familiarity with MOP/EOP (Method of Procedure / Emergency Operating Procedure) development and change control processes in a live critical facility.
* Ability to interpret as\-built drawings, control narratives, and network diagrams specific to the site, and to identify discrepancies against current field conditions.
* Comfort working in a 24x7 critical facility environment, including responding to on\-call escalations as required.
* Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to work directly with OEM technical support and field service engineers.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation Engineering, or related field, or equivalent hands\-on field experience.
* Site\-specific OEM training/certification on the BMS or security platforms deployed at the facility.
* Prior experience in a site operations, facility engineering, or critical environment support role.



  





**Soft Skills** 




  




* Strong ownership mindset and responsiveness in live\-site, time\-sensitive situations.
* Clear, concise communication with site operations, NOC, and vendor teams during incidents.
* Ability to work independently on site while staying aligned with portfolio\-level design standards and reporting lines.
